news.title: Foreign investors have dumped billions of dollars of Korean stocks this year despite record rally. Here's why
news.detail: The selling intensified Monday as the benchmark Kospi plunged more than 8% at the open, even as it emerged as one of the world's standout performers thus far.

insight.what: 外资抛售韩国股票，尽管股市创新高
insight.chain: 外资流出反映对韩国经济信心不足，可能传导至韩元贬值（汇率下跌）
insight.watch: 韩国央行利率决议及外资持仓变化

news.title: 光大期货0608热点追踪：美联储加息预期升温 银价大幅下挫
news.detail: 上周五美国5月非农就业数据显示，新增非农就业人口17.2万人，远超市场预期的8.5万人，4月数据上修至17.9万人，失业率维持在4.3%不变。

insight.what: 美联储加息预期升温导致银价大跌
insight.chain: 加息预期（借钱成本上升）推高美元，压制贵金属（无利息资产）需求
insight.watch: 美联储官员讲话及6月CPI数据

news.title: 原油基金罕见涨停！工业软件板块逆市上扬！

insight.what: 原油基金涨停，工业软件板块逆势上涨

news.title: 英国首相斯塔默斥资5.33亿美元投资人工智能芯片 支持“主权计算”
news.detail: 英国首相基尔·斯塔默周一宣布了一项旨在发展自主计算能力的新战略，承诺投入约4亿英镑（5.33亿美元）用于采购专用人工智能芯片，并支持本土初创企业。

news.title: Bidding war erupts for world’s oldest bank as Italy’s Intesa gatecrashes BPM offer
news.detail: Intesa on Monday announced an unsolicited offer of $35.3 billion, hoping to usurp its rival and create Europe's second-biggest ​bank by market capitalization.

news.title: Amazon unveils latest warehouse robot as tech giants continue AI layoffs
news.detail: "Our experience of robots is that it's actually driven up employment rather than the reverse," Amazon executive John Boumphrey told CNBC.

news.title: Inflation inside the electronics you buy may soon become a bit more sticky
news.detail: Most consumers are not familiar with the role resin plays inside electronics like smartphones. A current shortage of the materials may push up prices.
